question: Can large scenery stop dominating repeated physics broad-phase rebuilds without missing contacts?
hypothesis: Representing footprints larger than 64 cells as one bounding cell rectangle lowers index construction cost while returning the same candidate set for every query cell rectangle.

conditions.fixture: 5 large 140 m surfaces, 100 small bodies, 8 m cells; 80 rebuilds and 8000 queries per sample
conditions.comparison: 8 alternating old/new measurements in one Node 24 process
conditions.scope: CPU broad-phase only; no renderer or RealityGap changes

evidence: cell-rectangle candidate oracle passed for 90 varied objects including negative coordinates, updates and cache invalidation
50-step large-floor rigid-body comparison against old implementation passed locally
tools/profiling/spatial-broadphase.mjs reproduces the new implementation's fixture
PR branch strict TypeScript typecheck and production build passed with TypeScript 7.0.2
all three committed spatial-broadphase tests passed against locally built dist

acceptance.contact: large static floor continues to resolve body support
acceptance.performance: fixture median improves without claiming full-frame FPS

decision: Keep oversized path if repository typecheck/tests pass; investigate whole-scene gain separately
